response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, technically excellent individual contributor with strong developer-tooling credentials (test runners, TDD libraries, CI/CD setup, MCP frameworks) that align well with the 'engineering productivity' focus of this role. However, across 15+ years of employment history there is no evidence of formal people management or team leadership responsibility — all roles are IC titles (Developer, Senior/Staff Developer, Staff Engineer) with no direct reports, performance reviews, or org-level leadership mentioned. Since this is fundamentally a people-management role requiring 2+ years of team leadership, this is a critical unmet requirement despite strong technical alignment.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD pipelines)
15+ years of broad, high-caliber technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains
Demonstrated mentoring/teaching ability through workshops, Code Katas, and internal training (Selenium, TDD, Web Internals)
concerns: No evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or team leadership experience — a hard minimum requirement for this role
No mention of strategic roadmap ownership or leading organizational change at scale
Mobile platform experience is limited and dated (iOS/Apple TV work ended in 2016)

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools / testing infrastructure background
No recent mobile-platform or org-change leadership experience
